workaround.zh: 假设其目前直接在Google Photos中手动删除对应文件来保持同步。

rootObstacle.en: There is no real-time synchronization mechanism to verify how local file operations affect cloud storage.

test.en: Have the tester delete a file locally and immediately try deleting the same file in Google Photos to see if it’s blocked.

jobStory.en: When looking for a contact, a user using Outlook 2010 wants to merge contacts from multiple folders into one so they can search all at once.

workaround.zh: 假设用户目前通过手动复制粘贴的方式尝试合并文件夹，但这种方式容易出错且耗时。
workaround.en: The user likely attempts to merge folders manually by copying and pasting, but this method is error-prone and time-consuming.

rootObstacle.zh: 当前工具无法直接整合分散在不同分类中的联系人数据为统一视图。
rootObstacle.en: Current tools cannot directly integrate contacts from separate folders into a unified view.

jobStory.en: When handling moving appointment conflicts, developers want to display error alerts correctly in the interface so users can be aware of issues promptly.

pain.zh: 错误提示会在对话框淡出时就已经存在，导致可见性检查失败，进而阻止提示正常展示。
pain.en: Error alerts already exist when the dialog fades out, causing visibility checks to fail and preventing proper display.

workaround.en: Assuming developers currently must wait for the alert to fully disappear before checking visibility, or manually fix the state-check logic in the code.

rootObstacle.zh: 系统无法在动态界面元素消失的瞬间准确判定其当前可见状态。
rootObstacle.en: The system cannot accurately determine the visibility of dynamic UI elements at the exact moment they disappear.

pain.en: The directly accessible text transcript has too small font, causing eye strain when reading.

jobStory.en: When updating permissions for a role in an organization, developers want to directly call the permission validation function to quickly complete configuration.

pain.zh: 当前系统会遍历权限列表中的所有权限进行校验，导致不必要的性能开销和延迟。
pain.en: The current system checks every permission in the list, causing unnecessary performance overhead and delays.

workaround.zh: 假设开发者暂时手动筛选权限列表后再调用校验函数，但这种方式效率低下且容易出错。
workaround.en: Developers assume they temporarily filter the permission list manually before calling validation, but this is inefficient and error-prone.

rootObstacle.zh: 系统未限制权限校验仅检查新增的权限项，导致必须处理所有现有权限。
rootObstacle.en: The system does not restrict permission validation to only new permissions, forcing processing of all existing permissions.

test.zh: 创建一个包含已有权限和新增权限的测试payload，验证函数是否仅校验新增项。
test.en: Create a test payload with existing and new permissions to verify the function validates only new items.

stopIf.zh: 若函数仍遍历整个权限列表而非仅检查新增项，则说明该改进无效。
stopIf.en: If the function still checks the entire permission list instead of only new items, the improvement is ineffective.

jobStory.en: When on a business trip in the Netherlands, a person needs to obtain receipts for actual public transportation trips to submit expense reports.

pain.en: The person does not know how to use the preloaded OV-chipkaart card to record trip details, preventing them from obtaining compliant reimbursement receipts.

workaround.zh: 假设该人目前尝试手动记录行程信息或依赖他人协助获取凭证。
workaround.en: It is assumed the person currently tries to manually record trip details or relies on others to obtain receipts.

rootObstacle.zh: 缺乏直接从支付工具读取行程数据的机制，导致无法自动生成报销所需凭证。
rootObstacle.en: There is no mechanism to directly read trip data from payment tools, preventing automatic generation of required reimbursement receipts.

build.en: Build a simple tool function that reads OV-chipkaart transaction records and exports structured trip information.

test.zh: 让测试者使用模拟的OV-chipkaart交易数据，验证工具能否输出包含时间、地点和金额的行程条目。
test.en: Have a tester use simulated OV-chipkaart transaction data to verify if the tool outputs trip entries with time, location, and amount.

stopIf.zh: 测试者无法从模拟数据中提取任何有效的行程信息。
stopIf.en: The tester cannot extract any valid trip information from the simulated data.

whyNow.zh: 现有证据未提及该问题的解决状态，因此存在潜在需求空间。

workaround.zh: 假设用户目前只能自行承担已支付的预约费，没有已知的其他替代方案。
workaround.en: It is assumed the user currently has no alternative but to bear the paid fee themselves.

stopIf.en: If the system does not return any response within a reasonable time after a cancellation request is submitted, abandon the idea.

pain.zh: 他因意外提前下班而面临工作场所的严格监控与潜在处罚。
pain.en: He faced strict monitoring and potential penalties from his workplace due to accidentally leaving work early.

workaround.zh: 他假设自己需要自行寻找方式来掩盖或解释这次提前下班的行为。
workaround.en: He assumed he needed to find his own way to cover up or explain the early departure.

rootObstacle.zh: 缺乏即时、可验证的记录来证明实际工作时间符合规定。
rootObstacle.en: There was no immediate, verifiable record showing that actual working hours matched requirements.

build.zh: 一个能快速生成并提交工作时间证明的简单工具功能。
build.en: A simple tool function that could quickly generate and submit proof of working hours.

test.zh: 让该用户尝试使用工具输入当前时间并生成一份模拟证明，观察他是否愿意继续使用。
test.en: Have the user try using the tool to input the current time and generate a mock proof to see if they would continue using it.

stopIf.zh: 该用户明确表示不需要任何工具来处理这种情况。
stopIf.en: The user explicitly stated they didn’t need any tool to handle this situation.

whyNow.zh: 该投诉直接反映了当前工作中时间管理验证的痛点。

jobStory.en: When sending a calendar appointment via Outlook 10 to a boss, wants to set reminders to none so the appointment doesn’t appear with a reminder on t

pain.zh: 发送日程后不确定提醒是否真的被设置为无，担心日程在老板日历上显示错误提醒。
pain.en: After sending an appointment, isn’t sure if the reminder was actually set to none, fearing incorrect reminders appear on the boss’s calendar.

workaround.zh: 假设老板的日历默认提醒设置与自己相同，直接使用默认设置发送日程。
workaround.en: assumes the boss’s calendar uses the same default reminder settings as theirs and sends the appointment using those defaults.

rootObstacle.zh: 缺乏对跨设备日历提醒设置的同步控制机制，导致发送方无法确认提醒是否按预期被设置。
rootObstacle.en: There is no mechanism to control reminder settings across devices, preventing the sender from confirming if reminders were set as intended.

build.zh: 实现发送方可指定提醒设置并同步到接收方日历的功能。
build.en: Build a feature that allows the sender to set reminders and have them applied consistently to the recipient’s calendar.

test.zh: 用Outlook 10分别设置发送方和接收方的提醒为不同值后发送日程，检查接收方日历的提醒设置是否与发送方一致。

stopIf.zh: 发送日程后接收方日历的提醒设置始终与发送方的初始设置相同。
stopIf.en: The recipient’s calendar always uses the sender’s original reminder setting after sending the appointment.

whyNow.zh: 该问题直接源于当前日历工具的同步缺陷，无需额外假设即可解决。
whyNow.en: This issue stems directly from current calendar tool synchronization flaws, allowing immediate solution without assumptions.

jobStory.zh: 当需要定期整理Gmail联系人列表时，该用户希望自动执行重复项查找合并操作，以便获得无重复的完整联系人清单。
jobStory.en: When needing to regularly organize his Gmail contact list, he wants duplicate detection and merging to run automatically so he gets a complete list without repe

pain.zh: 他必须手动每次都使用Gmail的‘查找并合并重复项’功能，这耗费他的时间。
pain.en: He must manually use Gmail’s ‘Find & Merge duplicates’ feature every time, which takes time.

workaround.zh: 他是假设自己可以记住在固定时间手动操作该功能。
workaround.en: He assumes he can remember to manually run the feature at fixed times.

rootObstacle.zh: 缺乏无需人工干预即可定时触发重复项处理流程的机制。
rootObstacle.en: There is no mechanism to trigger duplicate processing at scheduled times without human intervention.

build.zh: 一个可在设定时间自动执行Gmail联系人重复项查找合并功能的简单脚本。
build.en: A simple script that automatically runs Gmail contact duplicate detection and merging at set times.

test.zh: 将该脚本绑定到用户常用的定时任务工具中，运行24小时观察是否实际执行了合并操作。
test.en: Bind the script to the user’s preferred scheduling tool and run it for 24 hours to see if merging actually occurs.

stopIf.zh: 24小时内未观察到任何联系人列表被合并的可见变化。
stopIf.en: No visible changes to the contact list indicating merging occurred within 24 hours.

whyNow.zh: 现有证据仅表明存在手动操作的痛点，无其他时间相关提示。
whyNow.en: The evidence only shows the pain of manual operation; there is no timing-related indication.

jobStory.zh: 当需要将Google Contacts Preview中的联系人导出为文件时，这个人希望完成该操作，以便获取可离线使用的联系人列表。
jobStory.en: When the person needs to export contacts from Google Contacts Preview as a file, they want to do this to obtain a downloadable contact list.

pain.zh: 在尝试从Google Contacts Preview导出联系人时，工具栏中不存在导出选项，只能导入联系人，导致用户无法完成导出任务。
pain.en: While trying to export contacts from Google Contacts Preview, the lack of an export option in the toolbar prevents the user from completing the export task.

workaround.zh: 该用户假设需回到旧版Google Contacts才能找到导出功能，但未验证此方法的可行性。
workaround.en: The user assumes they must return to the older version of Google Contacts to find an export function, though this has not been tested.

rootObstacle.zh: 当前界面设计未在联系人管理模块提供导出功能入口，导致用户无法通过标准操作路径完成数据导出。
rootObstacle.en: The current interface design lacks an export function entry in the contact management section, preventing users from exporting data via standard pathways.

build.zh: 在联系人列表页面添加一个显式的‘导出为CSV’按钮功能。
build.en: Add a distinct ‘Export to CSV’ button on the contact list page.

test.zh: 直接在Google Contacts Preview的联系人列表页面添加该按钮并测试点击后是否生成CSV文件。
test.en: Directly add the button to the contact list page in Google Contacts Preview and test whether a CSV file is generated upon clicking it.

stopIf.zh: 点击按钮后没有任何文件被生成，或生成的文件格式与预期不符。
stopIf.en: No file is generated after clicking the button, or the generated file format does not match expectations.
